title: Nike USC Trojans Team Football Baseball Cap Hat Red Dri-Fit University NCAA

descriptionText: Show your love for the USC Trojans with this stylish Nike football cap! The red cap features the team's logo on the front and is made with Nike's Dri-Fit technology to keep you comfortable during the regular season. This unisex adult cap is one size fits all and is perfect for any USC Trojans fan. Made in China, this cap is a great addition to any fan's collection. Whether you're a football or baseball fan, this cap is perfect for you!
